metadata.name: breakglass
metadata.description: Breakglass: emergency circuit breaker and outflow gate for Solana protocols

instructions.name: cancel_config
docs: The admin cancels a pending change. Phase 4.

instructions.name: check_outflow
docs: The outflow gate. CPI from the protected program's gate PDA. Returns
Allow or Hold; a paused scope fails with ScopePaused. Phase 2.

accounts.name: pause_state
docs: Writable for the auto-trip on a cap breach.

instructions.name: check_scope
docs: Read-only gate for non-outflow instructions: fails if `scope` is paused. Phase 0/1.

instructions.name: claim_held
docs: Claim a held withdrawal after `release_at`. CPI from the protected
program, signed by the owner. Returns Allow or Hold. Phase 2.

instructions.name: execute_config
docs: Anyone runs a pending change after its timelock, unless vetoed or cancelled. Phase 4.

instructions.name: freeze_held
docs: Guardian (or admin) freezes a queued hold. Phase 2.

instructions.name: init_flow_limiter
docs: Admin creates the outflow limiter for one mint. Phase 2.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The protocol's vault token account for `mint`.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Register a protected program with Breakglass. Phase 0.

accounts.name: admin
docs: It doesn't sign here: the upgrade authority below authorizes the
registration, so a multisig vault can be named admin directly.

accounts.name: upgrade_authority
docs: The protected program's upgrade authority. Only it can register the
program, so nobody can squat a protocol's config PDA and become its admin.

accounts.name: protected_program_data
docs: The protected program's ProgramData (BPF upgradeable loader). Immutable
or non-upgradeable programs can't be registered (fail closed).

instructions.name: pause
docs: Pause `scopes` (bitmask) for `duration` seconds. Guardian: bounded by the
max duration, cooldown and budget. Admin: unbounded. Phase 1.

instructions.name: propose_config
docs: Admin queues a timelocked change (raise limits, add a guardian, set
admin, release a hold, change policy). Phase 4.

instructions.name: reject_held
docs: Admin rejects a hold, through the protected program. Phase 2.

instructions.name: remove_guardian
docs: Admin removes a guardian, effective immediately. Phase 1.

instructions.name: renew_pause
docs: Extend running pauses by the guardian max duration. Guardian: own pauses,
up to the renew cap. Admin: any pause, no cap. Phase 1.

instructions.name: tighten_limits
docs: The admin tightens a limiter immediately (no timelock). Phase 4.

instructions.name: unpause
docs: Lift pauses early. Admin: any. Guardian: only its own. Phase 1.

instructions.name: veto_config
docs: A guardian vetoes a pending change. Phase 4.

types.name: ConfigAction
docs: A timelocked change. Anything that loosens protection or releases funds.

types.name: Decision
docs: What `check_outflow` / `claim_held` return (Anchor return data).
Deny never comes back as a value: Breakglass fails with `ScopePaused`
instead, so the error is attributed to Breakglass. The variant stays for SDK
callers that want an exhaustive match.

types.name: FlowLimiter
docs: PDA ["flow", config, mint]. One per mint, so write locks stay per asset.
Window math lives in `limiter.rs`.

fields.name: vault
docs: The protocol's vault token account for `mint`. Its balance sizes the bps cap.

fields.name: scope
docs: The outflow scope this limiter gates (and auto-trips on a cap breach).

fields.name: cap_bps_of_vault
docs: 0 = no balance-based cap.

fields.name: buckets
docs: Ring of outflow sums; bucket width = ceil(window_secs / 11), so the 12
buckets always cover at least `window_secs` (never under-counts).

fields.name: bucket_start
docs: Start time of the newest bucket.

fields.name: large_threshold_bps
docs: 0 = threshold is `large_threshold` only; else min(large_threshold, bps x balance).

fields.name: instant_allowance
docs: Zero-loss mode (Phase 3): amount per call that may skip screening (0 = screen everything).

types.name: GuardianLedger
docs: PDA ["gledger", config, guardian]. Created on the signer's first `pause` or `renew_pause`.

types.name: HoldKind
docs: Why a withdrawal was held.

fields.name: outcome
docs: 0 = claimed, 1 = released, 2 = rejected

fields.name: timelock_secs
docs: None = DEFAULT_TIMELOCK_SECS. Must be within [MIN_TIMELOCK_SECS, MAX_TIMELOCK_SECS].

types.name: InitFlowLimiterArgs
docs: Limiter parameters. `None` takes the spec default where one exists.

fields.name: scope
docs: The outflow scope this limiter gates (the scope `check_outflow` must be called with).

fields.name: window_secs
docs: None = DEFAULT_WINDOW_SECS. Must be >= 12.

fields.name: cap_absolute
docs: Required, > 0.

fields.name: cap_bps_of_vault
docs: 0 = no balance-based cap. Max 10_000.

fields.name: large_threshold
docs: Required. Withdrawals >= this are held for `hold_secs`.

fields.name: large_threshold_bps
docs: 0 = absolute threshold only. Max 10_000.

fields.name: hold_secs
docs: None = DEFAULT_HOLD_SECS.

fields.name: auto_trip_secs
docs: None = config.policy.auto_trip_secs.

fields.name: instant_allowance
docs: None = DEFAULT_INSTANT_ALLOWANCE (no screening). Used from Phase 3.

fields.name: screen_secs
docs: None = DEFAULT_SCREEN_SECS. Used from Phase 3.

types.name: LimitHoldQueued
docs: A withdrawal that would have crossed the window cap was held (and the scope
auto-tripped; `LimitTripped` and `Paused` are emitted with it).

types.name: LimiterParams
docs: Every FlowLimiter setting an admin can change (after `init_flow_limiter`).
Loosening goes through `propose_config(RaiseLimits)`; a change where every
field is equal or stricter applies at once through `tighten_limits`.

types.name: LimitsTightened
docs: The admin tightened a limiter immediately (no timelock needed).

types.name: PauseState
docs: PDA ["pause", config]

types.name: PendingConfig
docs: PDA ["cfgchg", config, id]. Created by `propose_config`; executable by
anyone at `executable_at` unless vetoed (guardian) or cancelled (admin).

types.name: PendingWithdrawal
docs: PDA ["hold", config, owner, nonce]. Created by `check_outflow` on Hold.

types.name: ProtocolConfig
docs: PDA ["config", protected_program]

fields.name: admin
docs: Usually a Squads multisig vault PDA.

fields.name: unpausable_mask
docs: Scopes that can never be paused (exit-safety paths such as repay).
